questions.prompt: A resource group has CostCenter=Finance. A new VM inside it has no tag policy or other tagging automation. Does the VM automatically receive that resource tag?

options.text: No; resource tags do not automatically inherit.
options.explanation: Use an explicit assignment or policy if the VM must carry the value.

options.text: Yes; every resource-group tag is automatically copied.
options.explanation: That is not the default resource-tag behavior.

options.text: Yes; billing tags and resource properties are always identical.
options.explanation: Cost-data inheritance and resource mutation are different mechanisms.

options.text: Only when the VM creator is the resource-group Owner.
options.explanation: The creator's role does not enable automatic tag inheritance.

questions.prompt: A resource already has ServiceOwner=Ops. You must add Environment=Training without removing ServiceOwner. Which CLI operation fits?

options.text: az tag create with only Environment=Training.
az tag update with --operation Replace and only Environment=Training.
options.explanation: Replace would omit the existing ServiceOwner key.

options.text: az tag delete followed by no additional operation.
options.explanation: Deleting tags cannot add the required new value.

questions.prompt: Existing supported resources need the CostCenter resource tag copied from their resource group. Which approach can apply that change across the existing population?

options.text: A suitable Modify tag policy and remediation task.
options.explanation: It can apply the parent-derived value to existing noncompliant resources.
Audit can identify missing tags but does not write them.
That affects cost records, not necessarily the resources' tag properties.

options.text: Retag the resource group and assume automatic propagation.
options.explanation: Parent resource tags do not automatically copy to children.
